title: Demonstration at Cornell University, Ithaca, NY, USA
author: Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed
description: The Bangladeshi students of Cornell University demonstrated their support to the Shahbag Movement. A snow storm was going on at that time and the temperature was -12 degrees Celsius. But the spirit of the movement could not be stopped.
